descriptionZh: 按已定稿 KCC-1/2/20 解析六字段代币；固定资产、扩展承诺与模板，禁用借用，支持 1–3 位继承人。主网为未独立审计的实验功能。
descriptionEn: Six-field KCC-1/2/20 Final tokens; binds asset, extension and template, disables borrowing, supports 1–3 heirs. Mainnet is experimental and not independently audited.

parameters.helpZh: 为签到与最终 KCC20 输出提供存储质量和手续费余量。
parameters.helpEn: Provides storage-mass and fee headroom for check-ins and final KCC20 outputs.

parameters.helpZh: 拥有者可签到或在到期前取回 Token。
parameters.helpEn: The owner can check in or recover the token before maturity.

parameters.helpZh: 正式参考实现每笔最多 3 个代币输出；本模板支持 1–3 位继承人。
parameters.helpEn: The standard reference supports 3 token outputs; this template permits 1–3 heirs.

parameters.helpZh: 1 分钟仅用于 TN10 测试。
parameters.helpEn: One minute is only for TN10 testing.

parameters.helpZh: 必须来自已验证的 Token 描述符和当前链上 UTXO。
parameters.helpEn: Must come from a verified token descriptor and current on-chain UTXO.

parameters.helpZh: 名称来自可选 Kascov 查询，不参与签名、模板绑定或资产身份判断。
parameters.helpEn: Fetched optionally from Kascov and never used for signing, template binding, or asset identity.

parameters.helpZh: 对描述符中的固定模板部分做承诺，不接受只靠名称识别的 Token。
parameters.helpEn: Commits to descriptor template bytes; token names alone are never trusted.

parameters.helpZh: 必须与当前代币状态相同；无扩展时填写 64 个 0。
parameters.helpEn: Must match the current cell; use 64 zeros for no extension.

invariants: Uses only KCC-20 Final six-field transfer cells, never legacy minter or seed programs
Binds exact covenant ID, BLAKE3 state-view template and extension commitment
Covenant-ID owner scheme is 0x04; borrowing is disabled while held in the will
Preserves token amount, fungibility domain and KAS value minus the explicit fee
Supports no more than three fixed heirs, within the standard reference output limit

example.titleZh: 把一个 TN10 KCC20 余额留给两位继承人
example.titleEn: Leave one TN10 KCC20 balance to two inheritors
example.scenarioZh: 先导入发行方提供并由本地验证过的描述符，再部署控制金库并把一个非 minter Token UTXO 转入该 Covenant ID。
example.scenarioEn: Import a locally verified issuer descriptor, deploy the controller and transfer one non-minter token UTXO to its covenant ID.
stepsZh: 构建并多人复核入金操作包
拥有者签到或到期触发分配
stepsEn: Build and review the funding package across devices
Check in or execute the mature distribution
example.cautionZh: 协议已定稿不代表本应用已审计。支持主网 / TN10；不接收旧四字段 Token，不能自动升级已部署遗嘱。
example.cautionEn: Final conventions do not audit this app. Mainnet / TN10 supported experimentally; legacy four-field tokens cannot be silently migrated.
